list.title: Online orders
list.text: Orders from the phone, Facebook and the website, from draft to delivered.
list.empty_text: Orders appear here as they are taken. Start with "New order".

new.title: New order
new.text: Who it is for, where it goes, how it is paid and what is in it.
new.find_item: Find an item by name or SKU, then press Enter
new.no_items: No items yet. Find one above and add it.
new.no_zones: No delivery areas are set in the rules; type the charge.
new.estimate: A guide: VAT and the final total are worked out when the order is saved.
new.saved: Order {number} saved as a draft. Confirm it to hold the stock.

order.pay_link_copied: Payment link copied ({amount}). Paste it into the customer's chat or SMS.

done.confirm: Confirmed: the stock is held for this order.
done.ship: Sent out: the stock has left the warehouse.
done.deliver: Delivered and added to the books.
done.return: Order taken back: the goods are in stock again.
done.book: Booked with the courier and sent out

order.supervisor_note: A supervisor cancels orders already sent out and takes delivered orders back.
order.cancel_note: Cancelling lets the held stock go. Money paid is given back.
order.pay_text: {amount} is owed. Record what was received.
order.cancel_text: The order stops here. Stock sent out comes back to the warehouse.
order.return_text: The goods come back to the warehouse and their sale is reversed; the delivery charge stays owed.
order.by_hand: Hand it over myself (type the courier below)
order.book_text: The courier is asked to collect {amount} on delivery. The tracking code comes back by itself.
order.courier_asked: The courier's latest word is on the order.

couriers.title: Couriers
couriers.description: Your accounts at delivery companies. Book parcels from an order; the courier tells us where each one is.
couriers.empty_text: Add your Steadfast account with its API key and secret key (from the Steadfast panel → API).
couriers.none_allowed: No courier can be added here (rule "Couriers that can be booked", or none delivers in your country).
couriers.name: Name
couriers.keys_help: Keys are kept encrypted and never shown again. To change them, type them all again.
couriers.webhook_help: In the courier's panel, set this address as the webhook and the token below as its Bearer token.
couriers.token_once: Copy the token now: it is shown only this once.
couriers.new_token_confirm: Make a new webhook token? The old one stops working at once, so update it in the courier's panel too.

payouts.title: Courier payouts
payouts.text: Cash your couriers collected at the door, and the payouts they send back. Tick the orders a payout covers and write what arrived.
payouts.no_couriers_text: Add a courier account under Couriers. What it collects on delivery shows here.
payouts.nothing_owed_text: This courier owes nothing now. When it delivers a cash-on-delivery parcel, the order shows here.
payouts.short: {amount} less than collected. Write why (for example a parcel charge or a missing payment).
payouts.mixed: The ticked orders are in different currencies. Record one payout per currency.
payouts.final: A saved payout cannot be changed. It goes into the books at once.
payouts.no_history: No payout from this courier yet.
